धोर् धोर्, cl. 1. P. धोरति, दुधोर,
धोरितुम्, to run well, to trot, to be
quick or alert, to have good paces: Caus. धोरयति,
यितुम्, Aor. अदुधोरत्.

धोरण, अम्, n. a vehicle in general, any means
of conveyance (as a horse, an elephant, a car, &c.);
a horse's trot; going well or quickly; (ई), f. or
(धोरणि, इस्), f. an uninterrupted series; tradition.

धोरित or धोरितक, अम्, n. a horse's trot;
[cf. धौरितक.]
